groan.definition:
n. an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v. indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
groan.translation:
n. 呻吟, 叹息
vi. 呻吟, 抱怨, 受压迫
vt. 呻吟地说

groaned.translation: v. 呻吟( groan的过去式和过去分词 ); 发牢骚; 抱怨; 受苦

groaning.definition: v indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
groaning.translation: n. 呻吟；活塞在气缸内的不正常声；哼声

groanings.definition:
plural of groaning
v indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
groanings.translation: (groaning 的复数) n. 呻吟；活塞在气缸内的不正常声；哼声

groans.definition:
n an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
v indicate pain, discomfort, or displeasure
groans.translation:
n. 呻吟, 叹息( groan的名词复数 ); 呻吟般的声音
v. 呻吟( groan的第三人称单数 ); 发牢骚; 抱怨; 受苦

groat.definition: n a former English silver coin worth four pennies
groat.translation: n. 格罗特(英国古银币), 少量

groats.definition: n. the hulled and crushed grain of various cereals
groats.translation: n. 碾去壳的燕麦(小麦)
